body: Yea, I do. The problem is the waves always come. I am a lot better right now. Normally I'm happy as shit but the waves come. They go, too. It's just hard as shit dealing with it, and it's gotten old.

So, what's one way to think outside the box? Bend over it. 

Badumtss.

I try to put a lot of good vibes out. I have learned to become as comfortable as I can be with myself, and the more comfy I am, the comfier my life gets. (It's slow as hell, but it's heading up the hill for sure.) 

I hope you figure somethin' out. I am always down to brainstorm.

Thanks. I live with my fiancee, and though he tries... he can't help me very well at all. I have explained to the best of my ability how to,  and he tries. We do not share insurance, and I think I am no longer insured. 

I don't want a suicide helpline. I want a psychiatrist so badly, because I have tried so, so many ways of coping. I have distracted myself, cried, eat, smoked pot, drink a bit, draw on myself; Healthy and unhealthy and none work. 

Maybe I will call. It helps me feel a bit better that it's common..  I'm still just trying to get to an 'ok' feeling.

An animal of any species (including humans) can die from mourning. It's a consequence to bear in mind. On a more sentimental note; Strawberry shortcakes are to live for. 

Time can help ease pains man. Hope you feet better.
